caseName: Rubinstein v. Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP
caseNameFull: Eran Rubinstein, et ux. v. Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until May 17, 2010, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
